goal: Complete the learner attempt lifecycle: resume-by-lesson (survives republish), persistent idempotency_records handling for submit/complete, atomic server-authoritative lesson completion with lesson_results persistence, learner progress/history/result APIs (owner-only, paginated, no answer keys), with comprehensive unit + Postgres Testcontainers coverage.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Resume resolves by lesson, not version: a learner with an IN_PROGRESS attempt on v1 gets that same attempt back after a v2 republish (resumed=true, pinned version unchanged); no second attempt is created. New attempt pins current published version only when no IN_PROGRESS attempt exists for that lesson.

Idempotency-Key persisted in idempotency_records scoped to (user, operation incl. attempt context, key): same key + same request fingerprint returns the stored response without re-evaluating or appending rows; same key + different payload -> 409 IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT; concurrent same-key requests cannot double-write; record committed in the same transaction as the operation.

POST /attempts/{id}/complete re-evaluates completion server-side: incomplete -> structured refusal (409, no status flip); complete -> atomic status COMPLETED + completed_at + exactly one lesson_results row; repeated/concurrent calls return the same result without duplicate rows.

Completed attempts are terminal: submits -> 409 (ATTEMPT_ALREADY_COMPLETED/ATTEMPT_NOT_IN_PROGRESS); GET reads still work; a new POST /lessons/{id}/attempts after completion creates a fresh attempt pinned to the then-current version.

GET /attempts/{id}/result returns persisted lesson_results (score, result_json, completed_at) for owned completed attempts; 404 RESULT_NOT_FOUND before completion; no hidden answer keys anywhere in the response.

Progress/history APIs: GET /me/attempts (or per-convention path) lists the learner's own attempts — current IN_PROGRESS resume info (attemptId, lessonId, versionId, cursor, progress) plus completed history — PageResponse envelope, owner-only; other users' attempts never appear.

Security: every new endpoint authenticated; ownership enforced on reads and writes; malformed JWT subject -> controlled 401 not 500; no learner API exposes DraftSchema.LEARNER_HIDDEN_KEYS (regression scan stays green).

Transactional consistency: submit mutation + activity_attempts insert + idempotency record commit atomically; completion + lesson_results atomic; concurrent submits/completes serialize on the pessimistic attempt lock without duplicates; published snapshots untouched.

Tests per brief §9: start, resume (incl. after republish), completed-cannot-resume-in-progress, correct/incorrect submits, progress persistence after reload, retry exhaustion, optional submits, idempotent replay + conflict, concurrent duplicate submits + completes, premature/incomplete completion refusal, successful + duplicate completion, LessonResult integrity, ownership/history isolation, no answer-key leak; TASK-0007..0011 regressions stay green; mvnw verify exit 0.

Docs updated: API_SPEC (new endpoints, idempotency contract, retention, error codes), LEARNING_ENGINE_DESIGN §8/§13 (lifecycle/idempotency/completion decisions), DATABASE_DESIGN if schema touched, task.json acEvidence.
